text:
marta: FYI canary on orion-liteq-v1 is spiking funcall parse failures for the checkout_tool suite. Seen ~8% malformed JSON vs 0.6% on baseline.

samir: ack can you paste an example?

marta: sure — expected funcall body, got trailing tokens. snippet:

```
{"tool":"checkout_tool","args":{"amount":49.99,"currency":"USD","user_id":"u123"}}
OK
```

elena: that trailing `OK` smells like sampling / EOS handling after quantization. did we change eos token id mapping in the ptq pipeline?

marta: not intentionally. onboard script used default tokenizer map from quantizer. we did notice slightly different tokenization length distribution (+1 token median).

ryan: deploy-bot flagged a canary alert: deploy-bot: [ALERT] funcall_parse_rate > 5% for orion-liteq-v1 in /canary (last 10m)

samir: hypothesis: quantized FP->INT path changes next-token probs around EOS/boundary, so model emits short free-text after JSON. two quick mitigations: 1) force `stop` tokens on call surface, 2) postprocess to strip trailing nonjson tokens before parse.

elena: both make sense. but stop-token may break streaming tool-calls that rely on incremental funcall detection. I'd prefer a conservative postprocess + tighten canary.

marta: running a 1k-sample eval now comparing parse_success between baseline and orion-liteq-v1 (temp 0.0, 0.2, 0.0+top_p=0.9).

samir: also worth checking KV-cache prefix alignment — if batch sampling shifts prefix boundary that could append partial literal. Can you repro with single-request mirror (no batching)?

marta: repro run on single-request mirror passed locally (parse success ~99.2%) but canary still fails at scale. suspect interaction with batching/autokv option.

ryan: quick ops ask: can we rollback or route canary to baseline while we triage? current routing policy allows instant fallback, I can flip it if needed.

marta: please hold for 30m — want the 1k-sample diagnostics first. If parse_fail uplift persists after switching batching off, we rollback.

elena: add metric: "postparse_extra_tokens" (count chars after last `}`) and capture top 50 examples to S3 for analysis. also add a small sanitizer in the client that tries JSON-first, then runs a guarded regex to extract the last {...} block as fallback.

samir: I can add a temporary canary-sidepost hook to run the regex sanitizer and emit a metric tag when used. will push within 15m.

marta: thanks — will update with 1k eval numbers. initial peek: temp=0.0 parse_success 99.1% vs baseline 99.9%; temp=0.2 drops to 91% for orion-liteq-v1. weird that deterministic sampling still slips.

ryan: noted — I'm standing by to route traffic if needed.

marta: 1768005580: upload done, putting sample artifacts at s3://redwood-canary/orion-liteq-v1/parse-samples/1768005555.zip (50 examples). anyone else want a copy?

elena: grabbing links now, will run diffs vs baseline. :mag:

samir: will follow up with a small kernel/quant patch that forces strict EOS tokenization mapping in the ptq export; if that fixes local mirroring we'll coordinate a canary redeploy.

marta: great. if we still see tail tokens after that, we escalate to model team for calibration.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [INFO] canary-metrics: funcall_parse_rate=8.3% -> alerted.

marta: thanks all — next update in ~20m.
